styleLock.lockText: Campaign Style Lock: consistent fresh home kitchen storage ecommerce visual system across the entire image set; fixed palette of warm off-white background #F7F4EF, muted sage teal panel #AECFC7, deep pine green panel #3B4A44, charcoal text #2D2D2D, and soft gold accent #C9A063; soft neutral studio key from front-left with natural window light for lifestyle shots; modern geometric sans-serif headlines in charcoal #2D2D2D; rounded gold pill-shaped info labels in #C9A063; thin-line rounded-square outline icons; clean product photography mixed with minimal infographic panels; stable product scale and centered placement; every screen composed as one complete balanced layout with natural breathing margins; no color palette changes, no mixed fonts, no random backgrounds, no inconsistent lighting, no mismatched icon styles.

provenance.notes: 17 片详情页长图切片提炼。源夹名「百货」仅为杂项大类，识图判定主产品为翻盖可视储米桶（透明桶身+翻盖卡扣+底部滚轮+量杯，粉/蓝双色、斜开/翻盖两款式），故归入 家居日用/厨房用品，与源夹名不符。已剥离：桶身贴标品牌字、二维码会员角标、视频占位黑块、英文装饰文案（含源模板遗留的无关英文标签）。多片白底产品图与深绿实拍图在压缩切片下不可辨，对应分镜按文案与版式结构重建；容量等具体数值一律以 {callout} 占位，未沿用源数值。
